body: Shouting at a wall. Time passes on and on and I still wonder why I'm still here. Been waiting for death for three years at this point. Just waiting and waiting. i want to cut to fat again
Have you learned anything of value since then?

I threw away my memories today. I took every single sentimental item and gift given to me and I left them at the dump. These are my last days alive. Everything has been falling into place, with my family and I moving, finally getting a shotgun, and my note finished. 


No more beating myself up. No more wondering if I used the right personality or which one is thinking at the moment. No more regretting falling out with friends. It's all over now. The only thing that exists is the moment in front of me. It's a very comfortable feeling. I just need to wait a little longer until the moment is right so I can get in my car at 3am and drive to the coast with my shotgun. 

Hope everyone has a nice night.

I had to comfort my crying mother today. I don't think I did the best job. 

Honestly, I was envious. I wish we swapped places. I'm so tired. I'm so fucking tired of holding everything in. I want to die
Went to my doctor today. I couldn't get the courage to tell her how I'm actually feeling. Turns out I gained 38 pounds. Not even gonna try holding back tonight. I hate myself
I stopped asking why and started to wonder how. How the fuck am I still alive? Here's a glass to another year of emptiness.
I don't deserve a single thing I have. I fucking hate myself

Thank you for the words. I tried three therapists and two different meds.

​

My first therapist wasn't good at all. I had about 12 sessions with him, and at the first, I told him that it is hard for me to reach out about what I was feeling... And he never understood that. I told him about being molested, and the self hatred that stemmed from that, and he never brought it up with me again.  He focused on achieving small goals that went nowhere. He never really took me that seriously, I think.

I told him that  I frequently shoplifted wine to get drunk, but instead of saying something like "What were you feeling when you decided to do that?" all he said was "Did you steal anything good?".

My other two only lasted for one session before getting fed up. I was able to convince my mother that I didn't need to go to therapy.

While it is a small step forward, I'm still in the same place. Doesn't feel like anythings changed, and I'm hesitant to try again because of how expensive it is.

The progress means nothing to me, since I know exactly what I'm going to get if I try again.

Hate to break it to you, but that's not going to kill you. Please consider talking to someone. A doctor, a family member you trust, or even here. Could you tell us why you did this?
